package_name: Chamba Deep Circuit (5D) — Bharmour, Manimahesh & Pangi Valley

itinerary.day_1: Pathankot → Chamba (Drive: 120 km · 3.5 hrs). Places: Chamba Town, Chamera Lake. Activities: Lakshmi Narayan Temple complex; Chamera Lake viewpoint; Old town evening.
itinerary.day_2: Chamba → Bharmour (Drive: 65 km · 2.5 hrs). Places: Bharmour. Activities: 84 temples of Bharmour; Chaurasi temple complex; Manimahesh trek orientation.
itinerary.day_3: Manimahesh Lake Trek (Drive: 45 km to Hadsar). Places: Manimahesh Lake. Activities: Drive to Hadsar trailhead; 14km trek to sacred lake (4,080m); Sunrise on Manimahesh Kailash.
itinerary.day_4: Bharmour → Pangi Valley (Drive: 120 km · 5 hrs). Places: Pangi Valley. Activities: Sach Pass (4,390m) crossing; Pangi valley landscapes; Killar village arrival.
itinerary.day_5: Pangi → Pathankot (Drive: 250 km via Chamba). Activities: Pangi tribal culture walk; Return via Chamba valley; Pathankot arrival.
